overall: AG found the Committee violated the OML by answering a minutes request late (5 of 8 sets past 10 days) and approving two sets of minutes beyond 30 days or three meetings; no intentional violation found.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly failed to provide or post requested meeting minutes within 10 days of a February 10, 2021 request.
allegations.key_passage: Five out of the eight sets of meeting minutes requested were not posted to the Town’s website or otherwise provided to the Complainant until after the 10-day period allowed for in the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged late approval and inaccuracy of minutes for 2020 meetings (March 12, August 4, October 7, November 4), filed more than 30 days after approval.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the allegations related to the timely approval or accuracy of the minutes for meetings held on March 12, August 4, October 7, and November 4, 2020, as the complaint was not timely filed with respect to those minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged minutes for the March 20, 2017 and December 3, 2020 meetings were not approved timely; both were approved October 26, 2021.
allegations.key_passage: However, with respect to the minutes for meetings held on March 20, 2017, and December 3, 2020, which were approved on October 26, 2021, we find that the Committee violated the Law where those minutes were not approved within 30 days or three meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the accuracy and content of certain draft minutes (2017, 2020, January and February 2021) were deficient.
allegations.key_passage: we find no violation of the Open Meeting Law as the minutes were still in draft form at the time the complaint was filed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the January 29 and February 5, 2021 minutes were not approved timely.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Committee timely approved the minutes where the minutes were approved within the next three meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged subcommittees had not posted their minutes, with separate violations expected against those groups.
allegations.key_passage: we do not conduct broad audits of a public body.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged a finding that the Committee intentionally violated the Open Meeting Law, citing the chair's and members' prior complaints.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore decline to find an intentional violation.

remedy: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of similar violations in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
